heading: `test` is a top-level clause
text:
### `test` is a top-level clause [LTSL.2.1]

`test` is a top-level declaration — one production alongside `schema`, `rule`,
`use` and `import` ([LGRA]). A `test "<name>":` block may
therefore appear inline in a `.ds` file, co-located with the rules it exercises, or
be collected in a `.dstest` file. There is one grammar. A `.ds` holds a program
plus any inline tests, and a `.dstest` holds `test` declarations and nothing
else. The compiler **must** refuse any other top-level declaration in a
`.dstest` with `DS_VALIDATE_TEST_COMPANION_DECL`, and a `use` directive with
`DS_VALIDATE_USE_IN_TEST` ([LDIA.2.10.6]).
